findings.evidence: Phrase states the humanist 'won a legal exemption from having to use AI at all,' but the only source snippet available is a headline ('Kentucky man becomes the first humanist granted religious exemption from AI') plus Hacker News metadata, with no article text confirming the exemption's exact scope (whether it covers all AI use or a narrower context).
findings.suggestion: Curate stage should confirm from the full article that the exemption is indeed total ('at all') before publishing, or soften to match only what the headline supports (e.g. 'won a religious exemption from AI').
